parameters.name: CompanyLimitType
parameters.description:
The type of company device registration limit. Valid values:

- **Unlimited**: No limit.

- **LimitAll**: Limit by total number.

- **LimitDiff**: Limit by device categorization.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number for paged queries. Values range from 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: MatchMode
parameters.description:
The policy matching target type. Valid values:

- **UserGroupAll**: Associate all users.

- **UserGroupNormal**: Associate some user groups.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the device registration policy. It can be 1 to 128 characters long. It supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase English letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of items per page for paged queries. Values range from 1 to 500.

parameters.name: PersonalLimitType
parameters.description:
The type of personal device registration limit. Valid values:

- **Unlimited**: No limit.

- **LimitAll**: Limit by total number.

- **LimitDiff**: Limit by device categorization.

parameters.name: PolicyIds
parameters.description: A collection of device registration policy IDs. You can enter up to 100 device registration policy IDs.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the device registration policy. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: UserGroupId
parameters.description:
The user group ID. Get this value from:

- [ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): Batch query user groups.

- [CreateUserGroup](~~CreateUserGroup~~): Create user groups.
